changes: Added explicit Koala terminal outcome semantics: dashboard/session brief now show Lifecycle DONE separately from DONE-success/default, DONE-blocked, and DONE-audit-only; summary_set accepts outcomeKind; verification evidence accepts verdict labels without changing gate semantics; worktree mirror-lag wording is calmer; focused outcome-semantics smoke covers regressions including corrupt persisted outcomeKind values.
usage: Run koala session_brief or koala dashboard to see lifecycle progress plus outcome buckets. Use koala summary_set --outcomeKind=success|blocked|audit_only before DONE, and optional verification evidence verdict=blocked_classified|audit_only|success|waived for classified evidence. Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke for focused regression coverage.
expectedOutcome: Users can tell whether a DONE story represents successful delivery, blocked-classified completion, or audit-only completion, and corrupt or missing outcomeKind metadata does not make DONE totals disagree with visible buckets.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run test:outcome-semantics-smoke printed outcome semantics smoke passed; node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-77e4 --json returned allPass=true with Verification intent coverage: 15/15 covered and 0 required missing.
outcomeDiff: No product-facing gap remains. The only caveat is validate still reports advisory fallback discovery text because this repo has no dedicated validate.ts or configured validate.command, but all commands and coverage pass.
limitations: No lifecycle split was introduced; DONE remains the lifecycle terminal state and outcomeKind is display/summary semantics. Legacy or corrupt outcomeKind values intentionally fall back to success/default instead of creating an unknown bucket.
pitfalls: Do not let verdict replace result semantics: result=fail still fails coverage even when verdict=blocked_classified. Also avoid parallel metadata writes for finding_resolve because one concurrent resolve was overwritten and had to be repeated sequentially.
